RedTeam Flex Release Notes: October 27, 2026 
 3 MIN READ 
 October 27, 2026 
Share this: 
General Update 
This is a tidy-up release: less clutter for admins and fewer tickets for accounting teams. Web changes are live today. A mobile app update that keeps your crew signed in arrives in the App Store and Google Play by next week. 
Improved 
Switch proposal forms on or off.
Each proposal form now has one Active switch (Configuration → Proposal Forms → Edit → General). Switch a form off and it shows crossed out and is no longer offered on new proposals or change orders. Anything already using the form keeps it and prints the same. 
Plans & Specs: one standard discipline list.
Sheets now use the standard discipline list on every project, so they're labeled the same everywhere. Use Tags for your own groupings, such as a building, phase, or bid package. Custom disciplines you created earlier now appear as Tags. Plans & Specs types are now Drawings, Specifications, and Other. 
Sage (hh2): retry a failed sync yourself.
If a vendor commitment or vendor change fails to post to Sage, click Retry, then Accept on the warning. Flex archives the stuck record in hh2 and sends it again. The failed line is replaced by a new transaction that shows Pending, then Successful Post, usually within a minute or two. If hh2 can't archive it (usually because the record may already exist in Sage), Retry stops and tells you why, and nothing is changed. 
Changed Behavior 
 Before
 After
 Before
 A proposal form could be off for proposals but still on for change orders.
 After
 One switch controls the whole form. Forms that were off for proposals are now off everywhere; switch them back on if you still need them.
 Before
 Admins could add their own Plans & Specs disciplines and types.
 After
 Disciplines come from the standard list, and types are Drawings, Specifications, and Other. Use Tags for anything custom.
Fixed 
 Grid search boxes keep your typing, even when nothing matches (for example, in Submittals).
 A rare timing issue that could delete a submittal just as its workflow started is fixed.
Coming soon to the mobile app
A new version of RedTeam Mobile comes to the App Store and Google Play by next week. It includes a new sign-in screen, and you'll stay signed in for 30 days, including if your company uses single sign-on (SSO). To sign in with SSO, enter your work email, then tap Sign in with SSO. Your company's sign-in page opens, then you're back in the app. If a session ends, offline work is kept and syncs after you sign back in. Update the app once it appears. 
FAQs 
 Will switching off a proposal form change projects that already use it? 
No. Projects that already use the form keep it, and it prints the same. 
 Can I still add my own Plans & Specs disciplines? 
Disciplines now come from one standard list. Use Tags for any custom labels; the custom disciplines you created before this update are now Tags. 
 Does hh2 Retry work for vendor invoices? 
Retry covers vendor commitments and vendor changes. For a failed vendor invoice sync, contact Support as before. 
 When will I see the new mobile sign-in? 
The app update arrives in the App Store and Google Play within the next week and may take a few days to reach every device. Once it appears, make sure you update RedTeam Mobile. 
 Need help? 
Visit the Help Center or contact your Customer Success Manager.
